HEEWON STYLE. Minimal iconic 2:1 still, composed for a 2:1 letterbox crop; nothing important at the top or bottom edge. NIGHT at a Jeju rich man’s timber gate: giwa eave, iron-bossed doors, oil lamps. MEDIUM WIDE, slight dutch. ONE DEVICE: the open gate as a warm rectangle of light. Center: the magistrate (FACE from chunnyun) bowing kindly, soft smile, gat, black robe — he LOOKS like a good man. Behind him his three daughters in clean silk (LEFT-TO-RIGHT sheet: Beknyun, Swinyun, Sipnyun) smiling, welcoming. Foreground: Wonganghami (FACE from wongang) pregnant, vermilion-orange po, grey bundle, wary but tired enough to step in. Warm lantern key — #d9b13a gold as hospitality light, never a glow aura.
